what.text: This page follows refugees from Vietnam living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3584 Vietnamese refugees in Germany, 17.4% of all refugees from Vietnam.
France hosts the most Vietnamese refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vietnam, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 26888 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 30786, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
